schema.narration_provider: always "google-cloud-tts" -- which TTS service voiced this video
schema.rendered_at: ISO timestamp the Remotion render finished
schema.updated_at: ISO timestamp of the last status change
schema.storage_path: GCS object path of the rendered mp4, used to re-mint a fresh signed video_url if the previous one expired
schema.video_url: time-limited (7-day) signed GCS URL, set once status is ready_for_review
schema.error: set once status is failed, the render/upload error message
schema.instagram_publish: { status: container_processing|published|failed, container_id?, media_id?, error?, attempted_at, published_at? } -- set by the publish-agent
schema.facebook_publish: { status: published|failed, media_id?, error?, attempted_at, published_at? } -- set by the publish-agent
